official_steps.name: Set up job
Run actions/checkout@v4
Run dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
Run Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
Format check
Clippy
Compile every default test target
Default regression within authorized scope
Fixed resource driver harmless fixtures and TODO consistency
Semantic HTTP capability snapshot and normal stdio query fence
Eval suite
P0 benchmark optional HTTP contract tests
P0 real MCP subprocess adapter
P2-A public surface real MCP regression
P2-B resolution dependency real MCP regression
P2-C durable recovery and freshness MCP regression
P2-D multi-language public truth regression
P3-A project config recovery real MCP
P3-B package and module recovery real MCP
P3-C Go package recovery real MCP
P3-C available independent module oracles
P3-D module boundary and architecture contracts
P4-A source fidelity and real MCP indexing
P4-B chunk budgets and live-session policy changes
P4-C document versions and source freshness
P4-D identity and chunk-quality gates
P5-A versioned retrieval lanes
P5-B bounded query execution and cancellation
P5-C generation, bounded assembly and final source verification
P5-D capabilities, query pins and public policies
P0 plan and corpus locks (historical ten-file DEV subset)
P7 semantic product disabled stdio contract
Post Run Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
Post Run actions/checkout@v4
